Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the post of
Librarian
which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
30
th
November 2022
.  Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste Certificate and Validity certificate.
Librarian :
1  Post Open
Qualification
&
Experience
– Bachelor Degree in Library Sciences from Govt. recognized Institute University with at least two years’ experience in a recognized research & educational Institute. Ability to use computers – hands on experience in office applications, spread sheets and presentation.  Desirable – Diploma in Computer Appication from a recongnized University or Institute and English, Hindi typing 30 W.P.M.
Salary:
Pay Level S-13 Rs.35400-112400 of Seventh Pay
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for open category candidates / between 18 & 43 for reserved category candidates.
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
